question: Do the headline fixed-mean dispersion contrasts depend on the realised 3000-cell subsample, on stratification by cell type or batch, on the cap, or on the local quality-control rule?
sources: original GEO-derived source matrices listed in the sampling audit; each dataset keeps its original 8000-gene list and the fixed 2500-gene shared panel; no gene re-selection

variants.reference: uniform without replacement, seed 0, cap 3000, original fixed QC; must reproduce the analysed cache cells, order, labels and split exactly
variants.uniform_s1: uniform without replacement, seed 1, cap 3000, original QC
variants.uniform_s2: uniform without replacement, seed 2, cap 3000, original QC
variants.uniform_s3: uniform without replacement, seed 3, cap 3000, original QC
variants.type_floor: cell-type stratified, cap 3000: each label stratum receives max(proportional share, min(50, stratum size)); proportional strata shrink to meet the cap; within-stratum uniform, seed 0; original QC
variants.batch_balanced: equal allocation across source batch levels with redistribution of unused quota, cap 3000, seed 0; datasets with fewer than two batch levels use the reference sample and are flagged; original QC
variants.cap10000: uniform without replacement, seed 0, cap 10000, original QC
variants.mad_qc: reference sample; fixed thresholds replaced by harmonised outlier QC: keep cells within median +/- 3 scaled MAD of log1p total counts and log1p detected genes, and with mitochondrial fraction <= median + 3 scaled MAD

original_qc: cells with >=200 detected genes; genes detected in >=3 retained cells define the mitochondrial fraction denominator; mitochondrial fraction <20%; unlabeled cells removed; datasets with <50 remaining cells excluded
labels: cells in the original annotated subsample keep their original labels; other cells receive labels by 15-nearest-neighbour majority vote from the original annotated cells of the same dataset, in a 30-component PCA of log1p counts-per-10k over the dataset's original 8000 genes; vote share <0.5 or a majority for unlabeled reference cells leaves the cell unlabeled
split: 70/15/15 per dataset with one generator seeded 42 iterated in the original dataset order, as in the original corpus
model: PCA-512 encoder fitted on training cells; negative-binomial MLP decoder with the E2 training recipe (hidden 1024/2048, 50 epochs, batch 256, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, 15 warm-up epochs, log-theta lr scale 0.1, bounds [-4,8], best post-warm-up validation NLL); Arm A predicts all 2500 genes from all 2500; Arm B predicts the fixed held-out 1250 genes from the other 1250 with input-gene library size
draws: Poisson on the fitted mean; shared per-gene NB with theta = median validation decoder theta per gene; per-cell NB with decoder theta; every draw shares the fitted mean

endpoints.calibration: median absolute log2 within-group variance ratio over expressed genes (real mean count >=0.5), log1p scale, on each arm's decoded genes
endpoints.marker: Welch recall@50 against real held-out cells on the 1250 held-out genes in both arms
endpoints.deficit: validation-only negative mean log2 Poisson-to-real variance ratio (E2 definition)

groups: dataset x cell type with >=20 test cells; deficit additionally requires >=20 validation cells
contrasts: per-cell NB minus Poisson calibration (Arm A, Arm B)
per-cell NB minus Poisson Welch recall (Arm B)
per-cell minus shared Welch recall (Arm B)
inference: average seeds within group, then groups within dataset; equal-weight mean over datasets; 2000-resample dataset-cluster percentile bootstrap, seed 20261105; group-level Poisson-win fraction also reported; slope uses the E2 random-intercept estimator with 1000 dataset-cluster resamples
stability_rule: a contrast is stable when its interval classification (below zero / spans zero / above zero) matches the reference variant; all effects and differences from the reference are reported regardless
composition: per variant and dataset: source, sampled, post-QC and analysed cells; label types; rare types (<50 test cells); batch levels retained; label-transfer share
retention: all variants, datasets, seeds and signed effects retained; no outcome-based exclusion
storage: panel counts stored sparse; fitted means not stored
